integrity: All tournaments through order six are exhausted. The uncovered set is computed by covering and two-step reachability, the minimal covering set by two exact stability characterizations, and every strict tournament is canonicalized under all relabelings.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a complete finite classification only at the first known disparity order. The inclusion and disparity index six are prior work; no larger-order frequency formula is claimed.
title: Complete first disparity layer for the minimal covering and iterated uncovered sets
